evidence: 103 evaluable non-MSI-high CRC; 13 responses, median PFS 1.2 months; ICI-naive
baseline_outcome_evidence: Clinical liver-status association; no baseline TGFB/CAF RNA predictor established; TMB/NLR did not distinguish responders
pharmacodynamic_evidence: PAI-1, IHC and RNA changes; paired IHC had zero objective responders and only two durable-SD cases
case_inference: Plausible, but no evidence of likely efficacy or proven post-BOT/BAL rescue
evidence_class: Uncontrolled efficacy plus exploratory clinical association and PD

baseline_outcome_evidence: Higher PD-L1 TAP and IFNG/CXCL9/CXCL10/T-cell-inflamed RNA associated with PR/SD. TGFB RNA/signatures did not associate with outcome. CMS4 1/13 PR; CMS2 5/23. TAP >5% 5/13 PR, but small overlapping subgroup. Blood TMB >20: 5/15; <20: 8/64. RNA sample count/cutoff definition not given in abstract.
pharmacodynamic_evidence: AACR 2026 poster: paired CD8/GZMB IHC n21 and PD-L1 n24; Xenium n8 paired blocks. pSMAD in PD1+ cells measured in only three patients (one PR, two PD). T-cell counts in spatial plots are cells, not independent patients. Local effects without falling systemic TGFB proteins fit immune-cell-targeted modality.
case_inference: Low recruitment RNA is not a favourable match; high bulk TGFB/CAF score is not a positive selector. PD-L1 RNA cannot be substituted for TAP. Current case-level efficacy remains uncertain.
evidence_class: Exploratory baseline associations in single treated cohort; no randomized predictive validation
freshness: Oct 2026 first-line chemotherapy/bevacizumab combination results do not validate a pretreatment TGF signature or isolate INCA efficacy; do not apply 71% first-line ORR to this later-line case.

evidence: 32 pretreated CRC; ORR 1/32 (3.1%), median PFS 1.3 months; only half had documented MSI testing, all tested were MSS
baseline_outcome_evidence: Sole PR was CMS4, KRAS-mutant MSS with highest tumour-cell PD-L1 (20%), but no observed TGF-beta activation; complement/MDSC signatures were higher
pharmacodynamic_evidence: No validated paired biomarker-response model established
case_inference: A single CMS4 response cannot justify CMS4/TGF expression selection; class rationale does not guarantee efficacy
evidence_class: One responder anecdote within a negative/low-activity single-arm cohort

evidence: 20 MSS patients (11 CRC, 9 pancreatic), no RECIST responses, 25% stable disease
baseline_outcome_evidence: Small fitted decision tree linked baseline IL17/IL2/IL1B tissue proteins to PFS. No external validation; cytokine protein concentrations are not case bulk RNA percentiles.
pharmacodynamic_evidence: 14 paired biopsies after 2-week NOX-A12 alone; Th1/IL2/IL16/IFNG induction and movement toward tumour associated with tissue response/longer stabilization. Tissue response is not objective response.
case_inference: High CXCL12 is a mechanistic lead, but does not establish likelihood of shrinkage. Low recruitment remains a competing limitation.
evidence_class: Small mixed-cancer uncontrolled study; exploratory baseline tree and PD

evidence: Randomized 55-patient CAF-rich HNSCC, not CRC; missed primary tumour-size endpoint, ORR 33% vs32%
baseline_outcome_evidence: All patients selected for >=5% alphaSMA CAF positivity; no biomarker-by-treatment interaction validates high CAF abundance as a response selector
pharmacodynamic_evidence: Prespecified secondary PFS HR0.58 at alpha0.20 (P=.1023), not confirmatory; paired transcriptomic CD8 signal but IHC/CAF changes not convincingly different between arms
case_inference: Selective CAF abundance alone cannot transfer this non-CRC result to likely efficacy; NOX4 protein not assigned in case
evidence_class: Randomized screening evidence with negative primary and no CRC predictive validation

evidence: Early CRC phase1b, predominantly ICI-naive/no-active-liver cohorts; trial subsequently terminated without Part2
baseline_outcome_evidence: Small poster biomarker groups: disease control associated with lower LAIR1 (P=.0142), trend toward more mature collagen (P=.0642); PR blood samples had fewer neutrophils/Tregs. Not a validated collagen-high or LAIR1-high selection rule.
pharmacodynamic_evidence: On-treatment collagen/immune remodelling differed by outcome in small selected samples
case_inference: Bulk ECM and shared LAIR1/2 protein assignment cannot reproduce these assays or predict benefit after BOT/BAL
evidence_class: Uncontrolled preliminary conference biomarkers, no validation
